en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Yahya Bin Abu Rafi’a, and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Nothing from the early morning meal remains inside up to the night, except for the rice bread’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from af-Sayyariy from Yahya ibn abu Rafi’ and other in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
No other food from lunch remains inside until night except bread of rice.’”
